description: Source code for the WorkerMain class in Playwright test runner, managing test execution, hooks, fixtures, and worker lifecycle.

classes.name: WorkerMain
classes.description: Manages test execution lifecycle, hooks, fixtures, and worker cleanup in Playwright test runner.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Stops the worker process and waits for ongoing tests to finish.

methods.name: gracefullyClose
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown of the worker, including closing browsers and fixtures.

methods.name: unhandledError
methods.description: Handles unhandled errors, marking tests as failed or stopping the worker.

methods.name: _loadIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads configuration and project data if not already loaded.

methods.name: runTestGroup
methods.description: Runs a group of tests based on the provided payload, managing test lifecycle and errors.

methods.name: _runTest
methods.description: Executes an individual test, including hooks, fixtures, and error handling.

methods.name: _collectHooksAndModifiers
methods.description: Collects hooks and modifiers for a suite based on the specified type.

methods.name: _runBeforeAllHooksForSuite
methods.description: Runs all 'beforeAll' hooks for a suite.

methods.name: _runAllHooksForSuite
methods.description: Runs all hooks ('beforeAll' or 'afterAll') for a suite.

methods.name: _runAfterAllHooksForSuite
methods.description: Runs all 'afterAll' hooks for a suite.

methods.name: _runEachHooksForSuites
methods.description: Runs 'beforeEach' or 'afterEach' hooks for multiple suites.
